orig_text:
The value of the AUTH payload is derived in a manner similar to the
usage of IKEv2 pre-shared secret authentication:

            AUTH = prf(SK_px, <message octets>)
correct_text:
The AUTH payload's "Auth Method" field SHOULD be set to "Shared Key Message Integrity Code" (2).
The value of the AUTH payload's "Authentication Data"  is derived in a manner similar to the
usage of IKEv2 pre-shared secret authentication:

            AUTH = prf(SK_px, <message octets>)
notes: The use of "Shared Key Message Integrity Code" is implied only.
